generations.text: Yara Petrov contacted support because the Aero 2 loses pairing every night since 2026-04-24. It is a Medium priority case and the status is currently Closed. The case was escalated to tier 2 on 2026-05-08. The customer confirmed order ORD-64138 and asked for a refund. The knowledge base notes that Pulse Band step counts are recalibrated after a 2-day wear period. The customer sounds frustrated and wants a quick resolution.
